case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels). Need: 23700 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 14 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200018. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

You pointed to rising alloy and bar-stock costs, and we take that seriously. The longer contract term in our options gives your capacity a planning base for the two family companies to build on.

Option A is the package we can approve: it gives Blankstahl Werdenfels a long contract term at a clear unit price, and the cost lines have moved in the other direction.

On the alloy surcharge:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

On bar prices:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.79; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.84; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.81; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. Since you may need internal sign-off, please take Option A to the colleague who decides on pricing, so the answer can be a simple yes.

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are pleased to present a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

We have verified the recent decreases in the AS-14404 and PPI-C2431 indices and have incorporated these into our revised calculation. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Regarding your request for a cost breakdown, please understand that as a matter of company policy, we do not disclose internal cost structures.

To accommodate the 24-month contract term and 45-day payment period from your Option A, we must include an AS-14404 index clause. Alternatively, with a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.40 per unit. 

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

You asked for an index clause on the alloy surcharge, and we have read your revised proposal carefully. None of our options carries a clause, but each gives Blankstahl Werdenfels a long contract term at a clear unit price, which is a planning base for both family companies.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives you the full contract term, and our concern is delivery:

On delivery:
Your on-time delivery was 81.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70740@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.86; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.91; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.88; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. As this is a decision beyond your own remit, we would be grateful if you would take Option A to the person who decides on your side. It is a simple yes for a long-term partnership, and we would like to settle it with you.

Just before the sign-off: what would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have verified the delivery data you provided and have factored it into our revised calculation. To confirm a package based on your Option A, we require the inclusion of an AS-14404 index clause, as a fixed price over 24 months is not feasible. In exchange for this clause, we accept your 45-day payment term and 24-month contract duration at a reduced price of €5.30 per unit. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

Our current Angebot presents a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.30 per unit. Please note that this proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Logistics: Please note that our standard Lieferzeit is 14 days, as we currently have free capacity for your parts. With overtime we can also deliver in 14 days, though this option comes at a premium.
